$comment: Agent notes for sending and moving messages. Shape and rules: scripts/api_notes.py. Every pitfall carries its source label; API means the catalog text quoted in cite, Official means the cited core.telegram.org page.

sendMessage.purpose: Send one text message, optionally with entities, a link preview, a reply and a keyboard.
use_when: short replies, notifications and prompts
the final text after a sendMessageDraft stream
avoid_when: headings, tables, media blocks: sendRichMessage
mainly one file: the media method

pitfalls.text: text is 1-4096 characters after entities parsing.
pitfalls.cite: text: Text of the message to be sent, 1-4096 characters after entities parsing

pitfalls.text: chat_id may be omitted only for an ephemeral reply to a callback query.
pitfalls.cite: chat_id: required unless the message is sent as an ephemeral reply to a callback query

pitfalls.text: message_effect_id works in private chats only.
pitfalls.cite: message_effect_id: Unique identifier of the message effect to be added to the message; for private chats only

pitfalls.text: Pace: ~1 message/s per chat, 20/min in a group, ~30/s in bulk, else 429.
pitfalls.cite: https://core.telegram.org/bots/faq#my-bot-is-hitting-limits-how-do-i-avoid-this

sendMessageDraft.purpose: Stream a partial message into a private chat while the answer is still being generated.
use_when: AI or long-running replies that should appear progressively
avoid_when: groups and channels: chat_id is a private chat
the final answer: persist it with sendMessage

pitfalls.text: A draft is a temporary 30-second preview; send the complete text with sendMessage to persist it.
pitfalls.cite: the streamed draft is ephemeral and acts as a temporary 30-second preview - once the output is finalized, you must call sendMessage with the complete message to persist it in the user's chat

pitfalls.text: draft_id must be non-zero; reuse it to animate updates, a new id replaces the draft without animation.
pitfalls.cite: draft_id: Unique identifier of the message draft; must be non-zero. Changes to drafts with the same identifier are animated. Otherwise, the draft is replaced without animation.

pitfalls.text: keep_on_stop keeps the draft only briefly; to keep the partial text, send it as a new message.
pitfalls.cite: keep_on_stop: The draft will still disappear after a short time or if the bot sends a message. To fully preserve the partial draft, the bot should send it as a new message.

forwardMessage.purpose: Forward one message of any kind to another chat; the forwarded message keeps a link to the original.
use_when: the audience should see where the message came from
avoid_when: a copy without the source link: copyMessage

pitfalls.text: Service messages and messages with protected content can't be forwarded.
pitfalls.cite: forwardMessage: Service messages and messages with protected content can't be forwarded.

pitfalls.text: message_effect_id works only when forwarding to private chats.
pitfalls.cite: message_effect_id: only available when forwarding to private chats

pitfalls.text: direct_messages_topic_id is required when the target is a direct messages chat.
pitfalls.cite: direct_messages_topic_id: required if the message is forwarded to a direct messages chat

forwardMessages.purpose: Forward 1-100 messages in one request, keeping album grouping.
use_when: several messages or a whole album at once
avoid_when: a copy without the source link: copyMessages

pitfalls.text: message_ids: 1-100 ids from from_chat_id, strictly increasing.
pitfalls.cite: message_ids: A JSON-serialized list of 1-100 identifiers of messages in the chat from_chat_id to forward. The identifiers must be specified in a strictly increasing order.

pitfalls.text: Messages that can't be found or forwarded are skipped.
pitfalls.cite: forwardMessages: If some of the specified messages can't be found or forwarded, they are skipped.

pitfalls.text: Service messages and messages with protected content can't be forwarded.
pitfalls.cite: forwardMessages: Service messages and messages with protected content can't be forwarded.

copyMessage.purpose: Copy a message of any kind to another chat without a link to the original; the caption can be replaced.
use_when: cross-posting a clean copy
re-sending a stored post with a new caption
avoid_when: the audience should see the source: forwardMessage

pitfalls.text: Service, paid media, giveaway, giveaway winners, invoice and widget messages can't be copied.
pitfalls.cite: copyMessage: Service messages, paid media messages, giveaway messages, giveaway winners messages, invoice messages, and widget messages can't be copied.

pitfalls.text: A quiz poll is copied only if correct_option_ids is known to the bot.
pitfalls.cite: copyMessage: A quiz poll can be copied only if the value of the field correct_option_ids is known to the bot.

pitfalls.text: Returns only a MessageId, and its message_id can be 0 when the server schedules the message.
pitfalls.cite: MessageId: In such cases, this field will be 0 and the relevant message will be unusable until it is actually sent.

pitfalls.text: A new caption replaces the original; show_caption_above_media is ignored without one.
pitfalls.cite: show_caption_above_media: Ignored if a new caption isn't specified.

copyMessages.purpose: Copy 1-100 messages in one request without links to the originals, keeping album grouping.
use_when: several messages or a whole album at once
avoid_when: a new caption: copyMessage

pitfalls.text: message_ids: 1-100 ids from from_chat_id, strictly increasing.
pitfalls.cite: message_ids: A JSON-serialized list of 1-100 identifiers of messages in the chat from_chat_id to copy. The identifiers must be specified in a strictly increasing order.

pitfalls.text: Messages that can't be found or copied are skipped.
pitfalls.cite: copyMessages: If some of the specified messages can't be found or copied, they are skipped.

pitfalls.text: Service, paid media, giveaway, giveaway winners, invoice and widget messages can't be copied.
pitfalls.cite: copyMessages: Service messages, paid media messages, giveaway messages, giveaway winners messages, invoice messages, and widget messages can't be copied.

pitfalls.text: remove_caption only strips captions; there is no parameter for a new one.
pitfalls.cite: remove_caption: Pass True to copy the messages without their captions

sendPhoto.purpose: Send one photo from a file_id (recommended), an HTTP URL or an upload.
use_when: a single image with a caption
avoid_when: 2-10 related items: sendMediaGroup
the file as is, not a photo: sendDocument

pitfalls.text: At most 10 MB; width plus height at most 10000; width to height ratio at most 20.
pitfalls.cite: photo: The photo must be at most 10 MB in size. The photo's width and height must not exceed 10000 in total. Width and height ratio must be at most 20.

pitfalls.text: By URL the cap is 5 MB for photos; a file_id is unique per bot, and resending a photo sends all its sizes.
pitfalls.cite: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sending-files

pitfalls.text: caption is 0-1024 characters after entities parsing.
pitfalls.cite: caption: Photo caption (may also be used when resending photos by file_id), 0-1024 characters after entities parsing

sendAudio.purpose: Send an MP3 or M4A file that clients show in the music player.
use_when: music and long recordings with performer and title
avoid_when: a voice message: sendVoice
any other format: sendDocument

pitfalls.text: Only .MP3 or .M4A, up to 50 MB for now.
pitfalls.cite: sendAudio: Your audio must be in the .MP3 or .M4A format / Bots can currently send audio files of up to 50 MB in size, this limit may be changed in the future.

pitfalls.text: A thumbnail can't be reused by file_id; upload a new JPEG under 200 kB, at most 320 px.
pitfalls.cite: thumbnail: Thumbnails can't be reused and can be only uploaded as a new file

pitfalls.text: By URL the cap is 20 MB and the MIME type must be right (audio/mpeg).
pitfalls.cite: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sending-files

sendDocument.purpose: Send a general file of any type, up to 50 MB.
use_when: logs, reports, archives and the original file as is
avoid_when: a photo or video that should render inline: sendPhoto or sendVideo

pitfalls.text: Up to 50 MB for now; the limit may change.
pitfalls.cite: sendDocument: Bots can currently send files of any type of up to 50 MB in size, this limit may be changed in the future.

pitfalls.text: By URL only .PDF and .ZIP work; upload anything else.
pitfalls.cite: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sending-files

pitfalls.text: disable_content_type_detection affects only multipart uploads.
pitfalls.cite: disable_content_type_detection: Disables automatic server-side content type detection for files uploaded using multipart/form-data

sendVideo.purpose: Send a video; clients play MPEG4, other formats may arrive as a Document.
use_when: a clip with sound, with an optional cover and start time
avoid_when: a silent looping clip: sendAnimation
a round message: sendVideoNote

pitfalls.text: MPEG4 is supported, other formats may be sent as Document; up to 50 MB for now.
pitfalls.cite: sendVideo: Telegram clients support MPEG4 videos (other formats may be sent as Document). On success, the sent Message is returned. Bots can currently send video files of up to 50 MB in size

pitfalls.text: A thumbnail can't be reused by file_id and counts only for uploaded files; a cover can be a file_id.
pitfalls.cite: thumbnail: Ignored if the file is not uploaded using multipart/form-data. Thumbnails can't be reused and can be only uploaded as a new file

pitfalls.text: By URL the cap is 20 MB and the MIME type must be right.
pitfalls.cite: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sending-files

sendAnimation.purpose: Send a GIF or an H.264/MPEG-4 AVC video without sound as an animation.
use_when: short silent loops, reactions and previews
avoid_when: a video with sound: sendVideo

pitfalls.text: GIF or H.264/MPEG-4 AVC video without sound; up to 50 MB for now.
pitfalls.cite: sendAnimation: Use this method to send animation files (GIF or H.264/MPEG-4 AVC video without sound). On success, the sent Message is returned. Bots can currently send animation files of up to 50 MB in size

sendVoice.purpose: Send audio as a playable voice message.
use_when: recorded or synthesized speech that should play as a voice note
avoid_when: music with performer and title: sendAudio

pitfalls.text: Needs .OGG with OPUS, .MP3 or .M4A; other formats may arrive as Audio or Document; up to 50 MB for now.
pitfalls.cite: sendVoice: your audio must be in an .OGG file encoded with OPUS, or in .MP3 format, or in .M4A format (other formats may be sent as Audio or Document)

pitfalls.text: Sending by URL: audio/ogg of at most 1 MB; 1-20 MB voice notes are sent as files.
pitfalls.cite: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sending-files

sendVideoNote.purpose: Send a rounded square MPEG4 video of up to 1 minute.
use_when: a short personal video message
avoid_when: a wide video: sendVideo

pitfalls.text: A URL is not accepted: pass a file_id or upload.
pitfalls.cite: video_note: Sending video notes by a URL is currently unsupported.

pitfalls.text: length is both width and height, the diameter of the video message.
pitfalls.cite: length: Video width and height, i.e. diameter of the video message

sendLivePhoto.purpose: Send a live photo: a short video together with its static photo.
use_when: a photo that should play a moment of motion
avoid_when: a plain still: sendPhoto
a URL source: it is not supported

pitfalls.text: The video is at most 10 seconds and 10 MB.
pitfalls.cite: live_photo: The video must be no longer than 10 seconds and must not exceed 10 MB in size.

pitfalls.text: Sending by URL is unsupported: use a file_id or upload.
pitfalls.cite: live_photo: Sending live photos by a URL is currently unsupported.

sendPaidMedia.purpose: Send photos, videos or live photos that viewers unlock for Telegram Stars.
use_when: selling access to media in a channel, group or private chat
avoid_when: free media: sendMediaGroup or the single-media methods

pitfalls.text: star_count is 1-25000; media holds up to 10 InputPaidMedia items.
pitfalls.cite: star_count: The number of Telegram Stars that must be paid to buy access to the media; 1-25000 / media: up to 10 items

pitfalls.text: In a channel the Stars go to the chat's balance, elsewhere to the bot's.
pitfalls.cite: chat_id: If the chat is a channel, all Telegram Star proceeds from this media will be credited to the chat's balance. Otherwise, they will be credited to the bot's balance.

pitfalls.text: payload is 0-128 bytes and never shown to the user; it is for your internal processes.
pitfalls.cite: payload: Bot-defined paid media payload, 0-128 bytes. This will not be displayed to the user, use it for your internal processes.

pitfalls.text: Paid media messages can't be copied.
pitfalls.cite: copyMessage: Service messages, paid media messages, giveaway messages

sendMediaGroup.purpose: Send 2-10 photos, live photos, videos, documents or audios as one album.
use_when: a gallery post
several files of the same kind as one message group
avoid_when: buttons under the album: the call has no reply_markup, follow with a message
one item: the single-media method

pitfalls.text: media must have 2-10 items; documents and audios group only with their own type.
pitfalls.cite: media: must include 2-10 items / sendMediaGroup: Documents and audio files can be only grouped in an album with messages of the same type.

pitfalls.text: No reply_markup: an album can't carry a keyboard.
pitfalls.cite: sendMediaGroup parameters: no reply_markup field (lookup show sendMediaGroup)

pitfalls.text: Put the caption on the first item; clients show it under the album.

sendLocation.purpose: Send a point on the map, or a live location the bot keeps updating.
use_when: a pickup or meeting point
live tracking of a courier or a trip
avoid_when: a named place with an address: sendVenue

pitfalls.text: live_period is 60-86400 s, or 0x7FFFFFFF to edit indefinitely; it must be 0 for ephemeral messages.
pitfalls.cite: live_period: must be between 60 and 86400, or 0x7FFFFFFF for live locations that can be edited indefinitely. Must be 0 for ephemeral messages.

pitfalls.text: heading (1-360) and proximity_alert_radius (1-100000 m) are for live locations.
pitfalls.cite: heading: For live locations, a direction in which the user is moving, in degrees. Must be between 1 and 360 if specified. / proximity_alert_radius: Must be between 1 and 100000 if specified.

pitfalls.text: horizontal_accuracy is 0-1500 m.
pitfalls.cite: horizontal_accuracy: The radius of uncertainty for the location, measured in meters; 0-1500

sendVenue.purpose: Send a venue: a point on the map with a title and an address.
use_when: a named place such as a shop, office or event location
avoid_when: a bare coordinate: sendLocation

use_when: handing over a support, shop or staff phone number
avoid_when: a text number is enough: sendMessage

pitfalls.text: vcard is 0-2048 bytes of extra vCard data.
pitfalls.cite: vcard: Additional data about the contact in the form of a vCard, 0-2048 bytes

sendPoll.purpose: Send a native poll or quiz.
use_when: votes, schedules and short quizzes inside a chat
avoid_when: results that need a custom layout: a keyboard or widget

pitfalls.text: A quiz needs correct_option_ids: increasing 0-based ids.
pitfalls.cite: correct_option_ids: A JSON-serialized list of monotonically increasing 0-based identifiers of the correct answer options, required for polls in quiz mode

pitfalls.text: is_anonymous defaults to True.
pitfalls.cite: is_anonymous: True, if the poll needs to be anonymous, defaults to True

pitfalls.text: open_period and close_date are mutually exclusive.
pitfalls.cite: open_period: Amount of time in seconds the poll will be active after creation, 5-2628000. Can't be used together with close_date.

pitfalls.text: members_only and country_codes are for channel chats only; no polls in channel direct messages chats.
pitfalls.cite: country_codes: for channel chats only / chat_id: Polls can't be sent to channel direct messages chats.

sendChecklist.purpose: Send a checklist on behalf of a connected business account.
use_when: a task list for a customer of a business account
avoid_when: chats without a business connection: the method can't be used there

pitfalls.text: Only on behalf of a connected business account; business_connection_id is required.
pitfalls.cite: sendChecklist: Use this method to send a checklist on behalf of a connected business account.

pitfalls.text: checklist holds 1-30 tasks; each task id is positive and unique in the checklist.
pitfalls.cite: InputChecklist.tasks: List of 1-30 tasks in the checklist / InputChecklistTask.id: must be positive and unique among all task identifiers currently present in the checklist

sendDice.purpose: Send an animated emoji that shows a random value.
use_when: a game of chance or a light interactive moment
avoid_when: a result the bot must decide: the value is random

pitfalls.text: emoji is one of 🎲 🎯 🏀 ⚽ 🎳 🎰 (default 🎲); values 1-6, 1-5 for 🏀 ⚽, 1-64 for 🎰.
pitfalls.cite: emoji: Currently, must be one of “🎲”, “🎯”, “🏀”, “⚽”, “🎳”, or “🎰”.

pitfalls.text: Read the result from Message.dice.value after sending.
pitfalls.cite: Dice.value: Value of the dice

sendChatAction.purpose: Show a short status such as typing or uploading while the bot prepares a reply.
use_when: a reply that will take a noticeable time
avoid_when: channels: not supported
waits over a few seconds: a draft or a status message

pitfalls.text: The status lasts 5 seconds or less and clears when the bot's message arrives.
pitfalls.cite: sendChatAction: The status is set for 5 seconds or less (when a message arrives from your bot, Telegram clients clear its typing status).

pitfalls.text: Channel chats and channel direct messages chats aren't supported.
pitfalls.cite: chat_id: Channel chats and channel direct messages chats aren't supported.

pitfalls.text: action: typing, upload_photo, record_video, upload_video, record_voice, upload_voice, upload_document, choose_sticker, find_location, record_video_note, upload_video_note.
pitfalls.cite: action: typing for text messages, upload_photo for photos, record_video or upload_video for videos

getFile.purpose: Get a file's download path from its file_id, then download it from the file URL.
use_when: reading a file a user sent: a document, photo, voice or video
avoid_when: resending a file: pass its file_id to the send method

pitfalls.text: Bots can download files up to 20 MB; the link is valid for at least 1 hour.
pitfalls.cite: getFile: For the moment, bots can download files of up to 20MB in size. / It is guaranteed that the link will be valid for at least 1 hour.

pitfalls.text: The original file name and MIME type may be lost; save them from the incoming message.
pitfalls.cite: getFile: This function may not preserve the original file name and MIME type.

pitfalls.text: The download URL contains the bot token: never log it or hand it to a client.
